pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions unless the primary trade has achieved a minimum of +$10.00 in floating profit and trailing stop is at breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require volumetric delta expansion and structural break of the 15-minute high/low before order execution to avoid noise wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% at +$10.00 and let the remaining position run via ATR trailing stop until $15-$30 target is secured.
